name: TA-3-cross-slope-trap
why: A uniform plane tilted so downslope is due east (tangent 1, ~45°). The direct row is blocked by NoData at (2,2), and the only geometric detours require a north/south move: a tight maxCrossSlope (0.5) rejects every such move, even though the SAME move's total slope (1.0, from the plane's uniform tangent) would pass either limit read as a scalar. Only pure east/west moves stay eligible (their cross slope is ~0), so the corridor cannot be walked around and the outcome is NO_ROUTE — pinning that the search is rejected by directional cross slope specifically, not by an accidental total-slope reading.
